### How to Live The Bible — The Sound of Freedom
Author: Mel Lawrenz
Site: Bible Gateway Blog
URL: https://www.biblegateway.com/blog/2018/07/how-to-live-the-bible-the-sound-of-freedom/
Passage: Leviticus 25:10
Points:
- The Jubilee proclamation in Leviticus 25:10 provided the foundational text inscribed on the Liberty Bell.
- God instituted the release of slaves and debt cancellation to show that He stands against oppression and for human dignity.
- People today still experience captivity to modern taskmasters like addiction, destructive guilt, and the desire to control others.
- Jesus fulfills the Jubilee by releasing believers from the Pharisaic burden of trying to earn God's approval through religious performance.
- Believers must actively remember and walk in the true liberty granted through Christ's grace and truth.

### "Happy Fourth of July Weekend" - PowerPoint - July 2, 2010
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/happy-fourth-of-july-weekend-powerpoint-july-2-2010-11634194.html
Passage: Leviticus 25:10
Points:
- The inscription of Leviticus 25:10 on Philadelphia's Liberty Bell highlights how biblical truth helped shape early American history.
- Early settlers and patriots viewed the proclamation of the Gospel of Jesus Christ as central to true freedom.
- Current culture has drifted away from its spiritual roots and stands in need of a fresh spiritual awakening.
- God does not require massive armies to transform a nation; revival can begin with one person answering His call.
